description: A table is covered with a large red tablemat and several colorful plastic dishes and utensils (red, blue, and yellow) spread across it. The right hand repeatedly reaches to the right side to pick up plates, cups, and utensils and place them off to the far right in small stacked groups, while the left hand stays near the front edge and occasionally steadies the mat; near the end both hands grab the red tablemat and fold/slide it into a neat stack toward the right.
